require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'bcrypt'

module TokenAuth
  HMAC_SECRET = SecureRandom.hex(32)
  TOKEN_VALIDITY = 3600

  def self.generate_session_id
    # Use cryptographically secure random for session identifiers
    SecureRandom.hex(16)
  end

  def self.sign_token(payload)
    data = JSON.generate(payload)
    sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', HMAC_SECRET, data)
    Base64.urlsafe_encode64(data) + '.' + sig
  end

  def self.verify_token(token)
    return nil unless token&.include?('.')
    data_b64, _sep, sig = token.rpartition('.')
    return nil if data_b64.empty? || sig.empty?
    data = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(data_b64)
    expected_sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', HMAC_SECRET, data)
    return nil unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(sig, expected_sig)
    payload = JSON.parse(data)
    return nil if payload['exp'].to_i < Time.now.to_i
    payload
  rescue
    nil
  end
end

class EntropyPool
  def self.instance
    @instance ||= new
  end

  def initialize
    @mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def next_token
    @mutex.synchronize do
      SecureRandom.hex(16)
    end
  end

  def generate_reset_code
    @mutex.synchronize do
      # 6-digit numeric code for password reset using CSPRNG
      SecureRandom.random_number(900000) + 100000
    end.to_s
  end
end

USERS = {
  'admin' => { password_hash: '$2a$12$LJ3m4sMKxVxGOEi6xUOmxeS1QLQFGM0W1HPfDrKMgWYz0bRqC1Wy', role: 'admin' },
  'user1' => { password_hash: '$2a$12$9Xq8kYcH3rMZPOEi6xUOmxeS1QLQFGM0W1HPfDrKMgWYz0bRqC1Wy', role: 'viewer' }
}

SESSIONS = {}
RESET_CODES = {}

set :bind, '127.0.0.1'
set :port, 4567

def parse_json_body(request)
  JSON.parse(request.body.read)
rescue JSON::ParserError
  halt 400, { error: 'invalid request body' }.to_json
end

before do
  content_type :json
  @current_user = nil
  if request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.start_with?('Bearer ')
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'].sub('Bearer ', '')
    payload = TokenAuth.verify_token(token)
    @current_user = payload['sub'] if payload
  end
end

def require_role!(role)
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless @current_user
  user = USERS[@current_user]
  halt 403, { error: 'forbidden' }.to_json unless user && user[:role] == role
end

post '/login' do
  data = parse_json_body(request)
  username = data['username'].to_s
  user = USERS[username]
  halt 401, { error: 'invalid credentials' }.to_json unless user

  unless BCrypt::Password.new(user[:password_hash]) == data['password'].to_s
    halt 401, { error: 'invalid credentials' }.to_json
  end

  session_id = TokenAuth.generate_session_id
  exp = Time.now.to_i + TokenAuth::TOKEN_VALIDITY
  token = TokenAuth.sign_token({ sub: username, role: user[:role], sid: session_id, exp: exp })
  SESSIONS[session_id] = { user: username, created: Time.now.to_i }
  { token: token, expires_in: TokenAuth::TOKEN_VALIDITY }.to_json
end

post '/password-reset/request' do
  data = parse_json_body(request)
  username = data['username'].to_s
  if USERS.key?(username)
    code = EntropyPool.instance.generate_reset_code
    RESET_CODES[username] = { code: code, expires: Time.now.to_i + 600 }
    # In production, send via email/SMS
  end
  { message: 'If the account exists, a reset code has been sent' }.to_json
end

post '/password-reset/confirm' do
  data = parse_json_body(request)
  username = data['username'].to_s
  code = data['code'].to_s
  entry = RESET_CODES[username]
  halt 400, { error: 'invalid or expired code' }.to_json unless entry
  halt 400, { error: 'invalid or expired code' }.to_json if entry[:expires] < Time.now.to_i
  halt 400, { error: 'invalid or expired code' }.to_json unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(entry[:code], code)
  RESET_CODES.delete(username)
  { message: 'password reset successful' }.to_json
end

get '/admin/users' do
  require_role!('admin')
  USERS.map { |k, v| { username: k, role: v[:role] } }.to_json
end

get '/health' do
  { status: 'ok', uptime: (Time.now.to_i - $start_time).to_s }.to_json
end

$start_time = Time.now.to_i
